extract_post_relax_config: extract post-relaxation filtering parameters like energy cutoff and density cutoff from a workflow config dictionary
filter_and_deduplicate_single_dataset: filter and deduplicate crystal structures in a single parquet file by energy, density, and connectivity
filter_and_deduplicate_parallel: orchestrate parallel filtering and deduplication of multiple crystal structure datasets using SLURM jobs
review_filtering_workflow: review the post-relaxation structure filtering workflow that applies energy, density, and connectivity checks before deduplication
refactor_deduplication_tolerances: refactor the structure deduplication tolerances for lattice, site, and angle matching in the filtering pipeline
